job.question: What was the proposal deadline in the Hawaii ERS RFP for private equity consulting services published in 2022?
job.acceptance: Accept date/time/Hawaii Standard Time equivalents. Issue date, RFP number and later best-and-final deadline are optional context.

reviews.reason: This is a 2016 South Carolina RSIC RFP for general investment consulting, not the 2022 Hawaii ERS private equity consulting RFP. Its proposal deadline applies to a different solicitation.
quotes: South Carolina Retirement System Investment Commission General Investment Consulting Services RFP
Deadline for Proposal Submission December 1, 2016 – 5:00 p.m. EST
